label: PF Backlog 81
title: Backend API: full backlog management for ALL scopes (project, product_forge, dashboard) + history/links/follow-ups
body:
Expose core/backlog.py over API so the dashboard can list and manage work items across every scope: per-project (products/

/backlog/), Product Forge itself/pipeline backend (product-forge/backlog/), and the dashboard's own backlog. Endpoints: GET /api/backlog?scope=project:|product_forge[&status§ion&origin&tag&q]; GET /api/backlog/{id}[/history]; POST /api/backlog (create); POST /api/backlog/{id}/{triage|accept|close|reject|update|follow-up|snooze|link}; GET /api/backlog/stats; GET /api/backlog/parked (due follow-ups). Tenant-scoped; actions routed through core/backlog.py (single writer). Refs: open.json/closed.json/counters.json/history/*.jsonl.
